Name: YAML Adapter for Content Patcher
Author: linkoidDev
Description:
[size=6]YAML Adapter for Content Patcher[/size]

YAML Adapter for Content Patcher is a framework that allows creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] content packs using human-friendly [url=https://yaml.org/]YAML[/url] instead of JSON.


[size=4]Installation
[/size]
[list=1][*]Install the [url=https://smapi.io/]latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Install this mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/0]Nexus Mods[/url].
[*]Unzip any YACP content packs into Mods to install them.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]For Mod Authors[/size][size=4]
[/size]
YACP works exactly the same as Content Patcher. The only things that change are the use of [b][u]content.yaml[/u][/b] files instead of [b]content.json[/b], and the YAML syntax.

For details on using Content Patcher, refer to the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide.md]Content Patcher Author Guide[/url].
For details on using YAML with Content Patcher, refer to the example [url=https://github.dev/linkoid/Stardew.YetAnother.ContentPatcher/blob/main/YetAnother.ContentPatcher.Tests.Content/content.yaml]content.yaml[/url] file.


[size=4]Migrating from JSON[/size]

An existing [u]content.json[/u] file can quickly be converted to a [u]content.yaml[/u] file
using [url=https://linkoid.github.io/Stardew.YetAnother.ContentPatcher/converter]YACP's online JSON converter[/url]﻿.


[size=4]Examples[/size]

Example mod file structure:
[quote]📁 Mods/
﻿📁 [YACP] YourModName/
﻿ ﻿🗎 content.yaml
﻿ ﻿🗎 manifest.json
﻿ ﻿📁 assets/
﻿ ﻿ ﻿🗎 example.png[/quote]
Example content.yaml file:
[quote][font=Courier New][color=#9fc5e8]Format[/color]: [color=#b6d7a8]2.3.0[/color]
[color=#9fc5e8]Changes[/color]:
- [color=#9fc5e8]Action[/color]: [color=#f9cb9c]Load[/color]
  [color=#9fc5e8]Target[/color]: [color=#f9cb9c]Portraits/Abigail[/color]
  [color=#9fc5e8]FromFile[/color]: [color=#f9cb9c]"assets/example.png"[/color][/font][/quote]
